rows: AO4 and AO5 levels, each with a quotation as evidence

parts.text: AO4: upper middle: clear tone; image of the market as a village sustained until the last paragraph
Evidence: 'the market wakes like a village stretching'
AO5: middle: some comma splices ('the crates thumped, the gulls cried')
Target: end by returning to the village image

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: AO4 upper middle, AO5 middle; target: return to the village image at the end and fix two comma splices.

points: Swap one verb for a precise one

a quotation that shows why you gave a level

questions.q: Place the model extract on the AO5 ladder with one quotation
questions.a: Middle, with a comma splice as evidence

questions.q: Core: peer-mark a classmate's piece in a breakout room: levels, evidence, one target
Extend: act on your own target: polish three sentences
Stretch: rewrite your ending to echo your opening
Which corrects 'The crates thumped, the gulls cried.'?
options: The crates, thumped, the gulls cried.
The crates thumped; the gulls cried.
The crates thumped the gulls cried.
questions.a: B) The crates thumped; the gulls cried.. A semi-colon correctly joins two closely related clauses.
B) specific and linked to criteria
